rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and injury to policyholder resulting from impact with another vehicle.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at high speed (35 mph, no braking) on Route 9 at a red light, resulting in a totaled vehicle with the entire trunk crushed into the back seat. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist from the collision. Other driver's insurance information is on file with the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended at red light, other driver traveling ~35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled vehicle, entire trunk crushed into back seat
